translations.web: as newborn babies, long for the pure milk of the Word, that with it you may grow,
translations.bsb: Like newborn babies, crave pure spiritual milk, so that by it you may grow up in your salvation,
translations.kjv: As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that ye may grow thereby:
translations.asv: as newborn babes, long for the spiritual milk which is without guile, that ye may grow thereby unto salvation;
